quests.conceptTitle: Punctuation Conductor: Choosing Commas, Dashes, or Parentheses (.)
quests.unpunctuatedSentence: My neighbor a retired firefighter helped put out the small fire
quests.punctuatedSentence: My neighbor, a retired firefighter, helped put out the small fire.
quests.ruleExplanation: Commas are the neutral, everyday choice for setting off an appositive without adding extra emphasis or de-emphasis.
quests.nativeTip: This appositive is worth mentioning but doesn't need extra dramatic emphasis or to be minimized.
quests.visualAnchor: 🖋️ Raw: My neighbor a retired firefighter helped put out the small fire ➔ Final: My neighbor, a retired firefighter, helped put out the small fire.

quests.conceptTitle: Punctuation Conductor: Choosing Commas, Dashes, or Parentheses (.)

quests.nativeTip: This detail is meant to surprise the reader, so it deserves more emphasis than a quiet comma.
quests.visualAnchor: 🖋️ Raw: My neighbor a retired firefighter of all people helped put out the fire ➔ Final: My neighbor—a retired firefighter, of all people—helped put out the fire.

quests.nativeTip: This detail includes some uncertainty, making it a minor aside rather than something to emphasize.
quests.visualAnchor: 🖋️ Raw: My neighbor a retired firefighter I believe helped put out the fire ➔ Final: My neighbor (a retired firefighter, I believe) helped put out the fire.
